mailboxes.title: Mailboxes
mailboxes.lead: The mailboxes Campbooks reads for {{workspace}}. Each one syncs on its own.
mailboxes.onlyYours: You see the mailboxes you connected. Owners and admins see all of them.

empty.title: No mailboxes yet
empty.lead: Connect one below and Campbooks starts sorting its mail.

loadError.title: The mailboxes didn't load
loadError.lead: Nothing changed. Try again in a moment.

health.needsYou: Needs you to sign in again
health.throttled: Paused by {{provider}} for a few minutes
health.needsAnother: Needs the member who connected it to sign in again

disconnect.question: Disconnect {{address}}? Campbooks stops syncing it and gives up its access at {{provider}}.
disconnect.choice: What happens to its mail in Campbooks

delete.title: Delete its mail from Campbooks
delete.lead: Its messages, attachments, search results and drafts leave Campbooks, for everyone here.

keep.title: Keep its history, read-only
keep.lead: What is already here stays readable and searchable. Nothing new arrives, and nothing goes back to {{provider}}.

disconnect.atProvider: Either way, the mail stays in {{provider}}: nothing is deleted there.
disconnect.doneDeleted: Its mail is leaving Campbooks. It is still in {{provider}}.
disconnect.doneKept: Its history stays here, read-only. Its mail is still in {{provider}}.

wayIn.removed: It also stops being a way to sign in to Campbooks: you added it by connecting this mailbox.
wayIn.unchanged: How you sign in to Campbooks doesn’t change.

errors.gone: {{address}} wasn’t found: it may already be disconnected. Reload the page to see the list as it is.
errors.notYours: Only the person who connected {{address}} can disconnect it.

connect.title: Connect a mailbox
connect.lead: You'll go to the provider to allow access, then come back here.
connect.none: This Campbooks has no mail provider set up yet. Whoever runs it can add Gmail or Zoho Mail.
connect.loadError: The providers you can connect didn't load. Reload the page to try again.
connect.signIn: Also use this account to sign in
connect.signInHint: Leave it ticked for your own mailbox. Untick it for a shared one, like support@: it is connected, but it doesn’t become a new way to sign in to Campbooks.

connected.title: Your mailbox is connected
connected.lead: Campbooks is bringing in its mail now.

stepUp.title: Sign in again first
stepUp.lead: Connecting a mailbox needs a sign-in from the last ten minutes.

refusal.unsupported: This Campbooks can't connect mail from that provider.
refusal.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then start again.

sign_in_again.title: You were signed out on the way
sign_in_again.lead: Sign in again, then connect the mailbox once more.

link_expired.title: That took too long
link_expired.lead: Connecting has to finish within two minutes. Start again.

cancelled_at_provider.title: Cancelled at the provider
cancelled_at_provider.lead: Nothing was connected. Start again whenever you're ready.

login_failed.title: The provider didn't let you in
login_failed.lead: Nothing was connected. Try again, or check the account at the provider.

provider_unavailable.title: The provider didn't answer
provider_unavailable.lead: Nothing was connected. Try again in a few minutes.

consent_incomplete.title: Mail access wasn't allowed
consent_incomplete.lead: Campbooks needs permission to read and send this mail. Connect again and leave mail access ticked.

account_mismatch.title: That was a different account
account_mismatch.lead: To reconnect a mailbox, sign in at the provider with that same account.

account_connected_by_another_member.title: Someone here already connected it
account_connected_by_another_member.lead: Another member of this workspace connected that mailbox. Ask them, or an owner, if you need it.

way_in_belongs_to_another_account.title: That account belongs to another Campbooks account
way_in_belongs_to_another_account.lead: Its mailbox can only be connected while signed in to that account.

mailbox_unsupported.title: This mailbox can't be connected here
mailbox_unsupported.lead: This Campbooks can't sync mail from that provider.

provider_not_configured.title: That provider isn't set up here
provider_not_configured.lead: Ask whoever runs this Campbooks to set it up.

no_offline_access.title: Ongoing access wasn't allowed
no_offline_access.lead: Campbooks needs to keep syncing while you're away. Connect again and allow it.

unknown_data_centre.title: That Zoho region isn't supported
unknown_data_centre.lead: Campbooks can't reach mail in that Zoho data centre yet.

no_mailbox.title: That account has no mailbox
no_mailbox.lead: The provider says there is no mail for it. Check that mail is turned on for the account.

unknown.title: The mailbox wasn't connected
unknown.lead: Something went wrong on the way. Try again.

admin.title: Connected accounts
admin.none: No account connected in this workspace.
